facts.fact: Gabon Fiber S.A. signed concessions with the state infrastructure holding SPIN on 2026-09-14 to build about 1,650 km of additional fibre extending the Backbone National Gabonais to Lambarene, Makokou, Ovan, Mouila, Ndende, Lebamba, Okondja, Ngouoni, Tchibanga and Mayumba; the AGP report says the company still intends to raise over FCFA 41bn on international markets.

systems.owner: state, via SPIN; extension by Gabon Fiber S.A.
